_: Recruitable gangsters (Gangster's Paradise). `before`: where they stand until recruited (story beats in story.json recruit them, flag crew_<id>). `home`: where they hang at the hideout once in. Loyalty 0-3 rises one step per loyalty scene (talk to them at the hideout, one per 3 days). `perk` by loyalty level. Sprites are placeholders until Art Prompts 11 Batch 3 (w213-w218).

deuce.name: Deuce
perks: Sells at +5% at the sell box
Sells at +10%
Sells at +15% and finds a coin in every chest

loyalty.text: You want to know why I don't cheat? I did, once. Uptown. The man I cheated is the man you're after, and he didn't lose; he just took the table. And the building. And the street.
So I deal straight now. It's the only thing he can't take.
The boys like you. The boys don't like anyone; they liked HIM, once, and look. I keep telling them you're different. Don't make me a liar, boss.
If this goes wrong uptown, I've got a table in a town three valleys over and a chair with your name on it. If it goes right... I've still got the table. Either way, you've got a chair.

deuce.finale: Deuce deals the lobby guards a hand they can't walk away from.

mama_rosa.name: Mama Rosa
perks: Meals heal +10%
Meals heal +25% and cost half energy to cook
A hot meal waits at the hideout every morning (+full energy)

loyalty.text: Forty men a night, and the fire wasn't an accident. Somebody wanted the block. You know who. Everybody who's anybody in this city is somebody he wanted the block from.
You eat like a farmer: fast, head down. Slow down. The food's not going anywhere. For once in this crew's life, the food's not going anywhere.
My boy ran with a crew like this. He'd have been about your age. ...Finish your plate. I'm not saying anything else about it, and you're not asking.

mama_rosa.finale: Mama Rosa's stew is the reason nobody in the crew goes down before the lobby.

specs.name: Specs
perks: Shop prices -5%
Shop prices -10% and the board shows reward values
Every door in Uptown is already unlocked

loyalty.text: The tower runs on a network older than me. I've been in it since I was eleven. Not deep. Sub-basement three is on its own wire. Its own WIRE, boss. Who does that?
I found my mother's name on a manifest. Crate 311. I don't know what that means and I've decided not to find out until you're standing next to me.
When we're in the tower I'll go for the wire. Don't wait for me. I'll be faster than you think; I'm always faster than people think.

specs.finale: Specs kills the tower's lights from sub-basement three.

ladder.name: Ladder
perks: A warning the morning before a thug raid
Raids come half as often
Enemies in gangster districts are marked on the map

loyalty.text: Four hundred and twelve trucks. Four hundred and nine went to the tower. The three that didn't went to a farm. Your farm. Before you got there. Think about that.
I was a kid on a roof when the river cities fell to him. I saw the whole thing. Nobody asked me what I saw. You asked. That's the whole reason I'm here.
From the tower roof you'd see the farm. I counted. On a clear day. I'd like to see that, after. Just once.

ladder.finale: Ladder calls every guard's position from the crane before you reach the steps.

vic.name: Vic
perks: +1 sword damage
+2 sword damage
Twin strike: every third hit lands twice

loyalty.text: Val says you fight like you're apologising. Val's wrong. You fight like you're counting. We like counting.
We had a brother. Not a twin. Older. He went uptown to box for the man and came back with a stone where his heart was. We put him down ourselves. We don't talk about it.
We're talking about it.
When we're in the lobby, you go left. We go right. Nobody goes middle. The middle is where he puts the ones who think they're brave.

vic.finale: Vic and Val take the right side of the lobby and hold it.

val.name: Val
perks: +1 defence
+2 defence
Knockback on you is halved

loyalty.text: Vic says you fight like you're counting. Vic's wrong. You fight like you've already lost once and decided not to again. We know the look.
The brother. Vic told you. I'm telling you the part Vic left out: the stone talked. In his voice. Said our names. That's what's in the tower, boss. Don't listen to it.
Right side. We hold it. Don't look back for us; Vic hates that.

val.finale: Val holds the right side of the lobby with Vic.

halo.name: Halo
perks: Ride between gangster districts (talk to Halo)
Rides are instant
The car is waiting at any district exit

loyalty.text: I drove for him. Three years. Never asked who was in the back. One night nobody was in the back, and the seat was warm, and I drove to the sea and sat there until morning. Haven't been back.
You never quit at the containers. I keep thinking about that. Most people, there's a container. There's always a container.
Car's gassed. Engine's warm. When it's done up there, I'll be at the steps, and we'll go wherever you say, and I won't ask who's in the back.

halo.finale: Halo's car is idling at the tower steps when the doors open.

dice.name: Dice
perks: Board jobs pay +10%
Messages: villagers' moods are shown
A second board job each day

loyalty.text: I run messages because I'm fast and because nobody looks at a kid with a satchel. Half the things I've carried I've read. All of the things I've read I've forgotten. Mostly.
Okay so one I didn't forget: a message from the tower to the docks that just said FARMER and a date. The date was two days before you got here. I'm just saying.
I'm going to be in the lobby. I'm going to be terrified. I'm going to be there anyway. That's— I think that's what you do? Is that what you do?

dice.finale: Dice carries the word down to the town: it's over.

the_kid.name: The Kid
perks: Run speed +5%
Run speed +10%
Grinding rails: enemies ignore you for a second after a dodge

loyalty.text: A hand comes out of the hood and draws a square in the air. A window. Then a line down. Then the hand closes.
...the cat sticker. Was my sister's. She's uptown. In the tower. Not a guard. Not anything. Just in there.
You get her out, I'll never say another word to anyone, ever. That's a promise. It's not even hard.

the_kid.finale: The Kid finds the stairwell nobody else could; it goes all the way up.

doc.name: Doc
perks: Heal 1 heart at the hideout each visit
Statuses on you last half as long
Doc patches you mid-fight once per battle

loyalty.text: I patched for him uptown. Two years. The ones who came down from sub-basement three didn't need patching. They needed something I don't have a word for.
He had a daughter. Seven. She got sick, the real kind, the kind I couldn't do anything about. He went up to the roof with her picture. He came down with a stone in his chest and no picture.
I'm telling you because when you get up there, you'll want to hit him. And you should. But there's a man in there, boss. I'd stake my hands on it.

doc.finale: Doc keeps the crew breathing in the lobby.

marlene.name: Marlene
perks: Sell gangster drops at +20%
Buys any item at full value
A relic from the tower every week

loyalty.text: I sold him his first building. A paper deal, a handshake, a man in a decent suit who said thank you. I've been trying to buy the handshake back for twenty years.
Paper is only worth what someone fears it for. You, they fear. Don't ask me why; I only know prices, and yours is going up.
When it's done, there's a deed in my safe with the right name on it. Your name. I've had it since the week you arrived. I wasn't sure I'd give it to you. I'm sure now.

marlene.finale: Marlene has the real deed waiting when you come home.

sasha.name: Sasha
perks: Thugs hesitate before attacking
Break doors and crates the pickaxe can't
Sasha opens the tower doors without the letter

loyalty.text: I carried the champion out nine times. Nine different champions. I never once got in the ring. Nobody asked. You didn't ask either; you just walked, and I came. That's the difference.
The chain's my mother's. Don't laugh. She worked the docks when they were docks. It's the only thing of hers that didn't go in a crate.
Doors, boss. Any door. Say the word and there isn't a door.

sasha.finale: Sasha puts her shoulder to the brass.
